purpose: Freeze R0 measurement extension protection domains before candidate renders; this data is forbidden as strict R1 conditioning.
held9_role: Internal development diagnostics; do not label independent test.

render_fields.depth_sum: premultiplied native camera depth; divide by alpha and meter_to_model=.1 for metres
render_fields.component_RGB: optional actual shared-sort RGB markers; do not invent current group RGB if absent
render_fields.environment_T_RGB: actual environment times residual transmittance, not intrinsic environment texture

metrics.foreground: For original a6/a37 domains report RGB MAE, measured camera-depth MAE, alpha*T mean; signed per-frame changes plus pooled means and p90/p99/max tails, counts >.02 and >.05.
metrics.road: Original known-road RGB; delete proxy RGB separately, measured world height/depth against actual support; standalone road alpha and actual joint road alpha*T; environment residual on independently verified unoccluded road.
metrics.preservation: Original protected RGB/depth and seam/outside pixel changes; no new candidate-alpha condition may shrink denominator.
metrics.fixed137: Keep 720-pixel ROI [230,204,270,222] including unsupported remainder; report geometry-known/unknown and actual support separately.
metrics.verified_extension: Freeze measurement-supported new road points/rays from R0 CPU construction before comparison; source RGB witnesses and unknown areas remain separate.

road_coverage_gates_from_original_plan.scope: independently verified unoccluded road; no foreground failure may be offset by road gain

numerical_preservation_thresholds.rule: This interface reports every signed regression and tail. It does not invent new acceptance tolerances or turn engineering success into quality acceptance.

strict_R1_separation: Do not mount integration_domains, original observations, full scene checkpoints, V44 renders, or old road assets into a blinded completion process. R0 is observation recovery/integration; R1 is separately conditioned controlled completion.
